beats.text: Hi, I am Adam, a Czech game designer. You may know me for my games Project L or Drillers. But today, I would like to tell you about one of my earlier games, much less known, but no less interesting: Snekagon.
This is a story about a game that didn't sell well, a story about a question I could not answer, a story about player psychology, and a story about the deep beauty and mystery of board games.
